securityPatches.change: Audit/attempt rows are intentional authorized local security logs; appendSecureFile enforces no-follow regular owned single-link descriptor and fchmod0600 before write. Salt read via stable bounded4096 descriptor. Both-copy regressions reject symlink victim writes.
ROX local integration/security helper modification or supporting regression documentation; inspect source diff against frozen vendor baseline.

readBoundedStable uses nofollow descriptor+identity checks; exclusive pidfile claim; new private mutation-lock serializes stale recovery and generation-checked release; tests reject duplicate claim and preserve differentgeneration.

Explicit user-selected paired iPhone bootstrap intentionally copies app-container boot credential and sends it only to validated IPv6 endpoint + integer port1..65535 to rotate. All health/rotation fetches redirect manual; fixtures prove no following cross-host bearer redirect, invalid authority rejected. No live devices used.
Cache reads boundedstable descriptor; cached and generated outputs writeSecureFile nofollow+singlelink+ownership+0600 descriptor, no pathname copy sink.
